text: I went to get keloid surgery behind my ear by a doctor at the Ladprao 48 Clinic. I was impressed with every step. The doctor was very kind and friendly. The surgery didn't take long, and all the staff were very friendly. The price was not expensive. I was impressed with every step.

This is such a lovely clinic! Let me explain. In September, I had surgery to remove a cyst. The incision was about 3 inches long and 2.5-3 inches deep – a large and deep wound. It was an incredibly painful time. The surgery itself was painful, but having to dress the wound "every day" was even more agonizing. Moving, sitting, standing, or lying down all caused immense pain. Even the amount of water I drank contributed to the pain because it's near my bladder. I was physically and mentally depressed. And I also had to pay the hospital 1200-1400 baht a day for the dressings – a very high price. Then I decided to get my wound dressed at this clinic. It saved me a lot of money! They're much gentler, less painful, and the staff (especially the mother who often dressed my wound, her name is Mae Nang – she's so lovely!), as well as the doctor, are incredibly kind and caring. It made those difficult times so much better. Now that I'm fully recovered, I wanted to share this review to encourage others and to express my gratitude once again for the excellent care.

I had the opportunity to have a keloid removed from my ear. The doctor and the assistant did a great job; they were incredibly gentle. Today I went to have the stitches removed. I told the assistant I was afraid of the pain, but it wasn't painful at all. It completely relieved my anxiety as someone who experiences panic attacks. Thank you for being so attentive to your patients. Dr. Nopadol spoke kindly throughout, and the other doctors were also very caring and never yelled. 🙏

I highly recommend this clinic for those on a budget. 🥰🙏🏻
